comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: From round 1 (slot 2): muster-harness's Daemon::start takes the binary path explicitly and muster-daemon's own tests use CARGO_BIN_EXE; crates other than muster-daemon cannot (no cross-crate CARGO_BIN_EXE). Decide how they get it at the cut-over, e.g. ./dev builds muster-daemon and exports MUSTER_DAEMON the way MUSTER_HERDR works today.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Needed before the seam's tests move: CARGO_BIN_EXE_muster-daemon exists only inside the muster-daemon package, so tests in other packages (core, cli, the seam) need another way to get the daemon binary built and located.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Done with the cut-over. One correction to this card and MIP-3 section 14: herdr's license and NOTICE lines stay. muster-detect is an Apache-2.0 port of herdr's detection, so its license travels with it; MIP-3 section 14 now says so.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-3 stage 2, tests and removal. Lands with a_2XJ1hqla3 and a_2XJ1i5JiA.

- Every daemon-backed test (about 200 of the workspace's 460 Rust tests, most of `muster-seam`) runs against `muster-daemon` through the neutral harness.
- `corpus/herdr-0.8.0` becomes the migration reference: the probe's scenarios run against the new daemon for every behavior Muster keeps, and every difference is recorded in the corpus with its reason. The 8 recorded conformance files and the herdr-shaped authored ones (`backend-intent`, `daemon-*`, `remote-daemon`, `socket-discovery`, `own-socket`) are relabelled or replaced.
- Delete: `crates/muster-herdr`, `crates/herdr-harness`, `deps/herdr.pin`, herdr steps in `./dev` (fetch, verify, schema check, staging) and CI caches, `HerdrLocation.swift` and the `--herdr-*` flags, herdr's license and NOTICE lines, `tools/herdr-probe` once the migration diff is done.
- `muster-perf`: `frame.decode` goes; `frame.vt_parse` and `mirror.apply` need re-recorded input.
- Close or retire the herdr-upstream cards in `uncommitted` that the cut-over makes moot.
title: Cut-over: the suite runs on muster-daemon, and herdr is deleted
